description: Photon Fusion brings scalable multiplayer networking to Defold as a drop-in native extension.
description_long:
Photon Fusion extension brings scalable multiplayer networking to Defold. It is built on top of the same battle-tested infrastructure that powers thousands of live titles across every major platform. You get room-based matchmaking, efficient state replication with late join support, forecast physics prediction and flexible RPCs. And better, everything is designed from the ground up to feel native to Defold's workflow.

Learn more and get started by reading the official Defold Fusion extension documentation.
name: Photon Fusion

releases.message:
**Photon Fusion 1.0.0**

This is the first public release of the stable version of the Photon Fusion extension for Defold. It includes an underlying Photon Fusion SDK with a replication system, RPC support, or map management APIs.

**Highlights:**

- Native Extension for Defold of Photon Fusion 3 SDK build 3.0.0.2433.
- Added networked object spawning and registration with fusion.spawn(), fusion.create_object() and fusion.create_map_object().
- Added automatic transform replication and selective replication of Defold script properties, with configurable replication modes.
- Added object ownership and authority APIs, including ownership requests, owner modes and configurable send rates.
- Added RPC support with player/object targeting and broadcast subscriptions.
- Added map management APIs: map_add(), map_change(), map_remove() and map_is_valid().
- Added network time, RTT, player count and connection state APIs.
- Added interest management with global, area and user interest keys.
- Added configurable connection protocols, including WebSocket/WSS support for HTML5.
- Added API reference, manuals and example project showcasing the public API.

Includes support for HTML5, Android, iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux.

**Read the official documentation**: https://defold.com/extension-photon-fusion/

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/defold/extension-photon-fusion/compare/0.5.0...1.0
